ingameEffects.label: Decibel Monologue (W-Engine Passive)
ingameEffects.description: While not the active character, the equipper's Energy Regen is increased. When the equipper uses an EX Special Attack and deals Physical DMG, all squad members gain a buff that increases their DMG dealt for 40s, stacking up to 2 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration. At 2 stacks, characters gain additional ATK. Only one instance of this effect can exist in the same squad.
ingameEffects.shortDescription: The equipper's Energy Regen is increased while off-field.
